page0: why is the trajectory ledger empty
objective: Make Trajectory load durable append-only repository checkpoints from parallel workers in addition to browser-local/manual checkpoints, so the owner sees existing project history on any device instead of an empty localStorage-only ledger.
diagnosis: trajectory-ledger.html currently initializes only from localStorage key moor.trajectory.v1.
convergence-funnel.html writes compatible checkpoints to that same browser-local key.
Repository, Funnel, Dev Feed and parallel-chat work is not hydrated into the page.
Therefore a fresh browser/device legitimately renders an empty ledger even when real trajectory evidence exists.
implementation: Create unique append-only checkpoint files under trajectory/events/ for existing evidence-backed work.
Update trajectory-ledger.html to load repository checkpoints through GitHub Contents API once on startup and on explicit refresh.
Merge canonical and local checkpoints by stable checkpoint identity without overwriting local manual history.
Keep scores optional; canonical seed history may remain unscored.
Expose source badge so repository-canonical and browser-local checkpoints are distinguishable.
Add CI checks proving a fresh localStorage ledger still renders canonical checkpoint history.
done_criteria: Fresh browser with empty localStorage receives canonical trajectory checkpoints.
Local/manual checkpoints remain preserved and merge with canonical history.
Parallel workers can append unique repository checkpoint files without sharing one mutable ledger.
No synthetic Trajectory score is invented for unscored canonical checkpoints.
Convergence Funnel local append behavior remains compatible.
Sealed Funnel replay and CI checks pass.
honest_limits: The static browser cannot write repository checkpoints itself; workers/agents append them through Git/GitHub.
GitHub API hydration is near-real-time on refresh/open, not push streaming.
Canonical history only contains checkpoints workers actually emit; older work not yet backfilled will not appear automatically.
